name: White Chili-Style Chickpea Soup with Corn, Zucchini & Bread Crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 jalapeño peppers
6 sticks celery
6 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and place in a large bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Trim and medium dice zucchini. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add flour to the pot with the veggies. Cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute.

Add beans with their liquid (do not drain) and broth to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and soup thickens slightly, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add bread crumbs and toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to the bowl with the cilantro, along with salt, and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice.
When the soup has thickened, add cream and corn to the pot, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy whipping cream
2 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with bread crumbs and avocado. Enjoy!
